summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology focused on on-device machine learning performance. Wrote custom CUDA kernels and TensorRT-optimized inference pipelines that cut latency by up to 5.2x on Jetson hardware, and applied 8-bit quantization to compress a 1.1B-parameter language model by roughly 55% with under 1% accuracy loss. Comfortable across the full model lifecycle, from training and evaluation in PyTorch and Hugging Face Transformers to exporting models to ONNX and TFLite for constrained edge deployment.

experience.title: Deep Learning Intern
bullets: Curated and annotated a custom toothbrush detection dataset for health-level classification using YOLOv8.
Trained YOLOv8n on 1,133 annotated images achieving 83% mAP@50 on held-out validation; exported to ONNX and TFLite for mobile deployment.

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Fine-tuned DONUT, an OCR-free visual document transformer, in PyTorch using the Hugging Face VisionEncoderDecoder API on a custom medical billing dataset.
Improved validation accuracy from 55% to 93% via improved preprocessing and model tuning.

experience.title: Research Fellowship
bullets: Trained U-Net segmentation with VGG-16, VGG-19, and ResNet-50 backbones; evaluated on Dice/IoU and reported accuracy-latency trade-offs for deployment.
Led a cross-cultural team of 7 as the sole ML-experienced student; delivered the full pipeline within a 6-week window.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Integrated faster-whisper STT (1.0–1.4s) and TensorRT-optimized YOLO for visual servoing on Jetson+Arduino, achieving a 5.2x speedup (56.7→10.9 ms, 17.6→92 FPS) over eager PyTorch inference.
Resolved 11 integration failures across the runtime pipeline; achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end-to-end voice-to-picked latency.

projects.name: SLM Compression and Benchmarking for Edge Deployment
bullets: Reduced GPU memory footprint by ~55% via 8-bit quantization (bitsandbytes LLM.int8()) on TinyLlama 1.1B; profiled peak VRAM and inference latency across prompt types using pynvml.
Benchmarked across HellaSwag, GSM8K, and ARC — under 1% accuracy degradation, evaluating efficiency versus task performance trade-offs for edge deployment.

projects.name: CUDA Kernel Optimization for VGG16 Inference
bullets: Replaced TorchScript convolution layers in VGG16 with custom CUDA C++ kernels using memory coalescing and constant memory for weights/biases, eliminating per-layer allocation overhead.
Coalesced kernel ran at 49.2ms vs 73.3ms (uncoalesced) and 77.5ms (CPU TorchScript) — ~35% speedup over naive GPU with identical classification accuracy.

projects.name: COFFIN – Whisper-Style ASR from Scratch
bullets: Built an end-to-end ASR pipeline (mel spectrogram encoder + causal Transformer decoder), trained on 1,000 Indian-English samples.
Designed a custom BPE tokenizer with a Cython-accelerated backend, a 4–5.5x speedup over pure Python; reached 15% WER on a Hindi-English dataset.
